Method of Attack: Encrypts victim data using AES algorithm in CBC mode with a static password derived from a key using PBKDF2 with a fixed salt
Appends .KEYGROUP777TG file extension to encrypted files
Uses Windows living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBins) to delete Volume Shadow copies
Alters host addresses of anti-virus products to prevent updates
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection via Key Group ransomware
